name: Ultra-low-temperature storage of frozen Pfizer-BioNTech COMIRNATY (KP.2) mRNA vaccine vials at -90 C to -60 C
plain_name: Keep mRNA vaccine vials frozen in an ultra-cold freezer
description: Vaccine-depot storage: frozen vials are kept in an ultra-low-temperature (ULT) freezer between -90 C and -60 C until expiry and must not be stored at -25 C to -15 C; thawed vials go to a 2-8 C fridge for up to 10 weeks.
keywords: Keep mRNA vaccine vials frozen in an ultra-cold freezer

sources.citation: Ontario Ministry of Health, Chapter 1: Storage and Handling of Pfizer-BioNTech's COVID-19 Vaccines, Version 8.0 (October 22, 2024)

requirements.rationale: The storage space must reach -60 C or colder (warm edge of the permitted -90 C to -60 C window).

The storage space must also be settable no colder than -90 C (cold edge of the window); with the previous requirement the machine range must overlap -90 C to -60 C, which excludes nitrogen storage that only runs far below -90 C.
Same -60 C limit for machines that document only their lowest temperature (portable ULT units qualify).

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
